verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o le ALII ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.sm: O le uluai aso o le masina muamua e te faatuina ai le malumalu o lc falc fetafai o lc faapotopotoga.

verses.en: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
verses.sm: E tc tuuina ai foi le atoUa faatuina le malumalu laau o le tulafono, ma puipui atu le atolaau i le je puipui.

verses.en: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
verses.sm: E te avane ai foi le laoai, e te teuteu ai foi o mea e teuteu i ai; e te avane ai foi le tuugalamepa, ma faaee ai ona lamepa.

verses.en: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.sm: E te tuuina foi le fata auro e mu ai le mea manogi i luma o le atolaau o le tulafono, ma e tautau le ie puipui o le faitotoa i le malumalu.

verses.en: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.sm: E te tuu foi le fata e fai.ai taulaga mu i luma o le faitotoa O le malumalu o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
verses.sm: E te tuu foi le tanoa e mulumulu ai ile va o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga ma le fata faitaulaga; e te sasaa foi i ai le vai.

verses.en: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
verses.sm: E te faatuina foi le lotoa e siosioina ai, ma ia e tautau le ie puipui i le faitotoa o le lotoa.

verses.en: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.
verses.sm: E te ave foi le uu e faauu a'i, e te faauu a“ le malumalu, ma mea uma lava e i ai, ma e faapaiaina ai, ma ana mea uma lava, ona paia ai lava lea.

verses.en: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.
verses.sm: E te faauu foi le fata e fai ai taulaga mu, atoa ma ana mea uma; e te faapaiaina foi le fata faitaulaga, ona fai lea ma fata faitaulaga e sili ona paia.

verses.en: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
verses.sm: E te faauu foi le tanoa e mulumulu ai ma lona tulaga, ma e faapaiaina ai.

verses.en: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
verses.sm: E te faalatalataina mai foi Arona ma ona atalii i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga, e te faatacele foi ia i latou i le vai.

verses.en: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
verses.sm: E te faaofuina foi Arona i ofu sa, ma e faauuina o ia, ma faapaiaina o ia, ina ia faia le faiva o ositaulaga ia te au;

verses.en: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:
verses.sm: o ona atalii e te faalatalataina mai foi i latou, ma e faaofuina i latou i ofu tino;

verses.en: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
verses.sm: e te faauuina foi i latou, faapei ona e faauuina lo latou tama, ina ia latou faia le faiva o ositaulaga ia te au; e fai lava lo latou faauuina ia i latou ma tofiga i le faiva o ositaulaga e faavavau i o latou tupulaga amuli.

verses.en: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.
verses.sm: Ona faia lea e Mose e tusa ma mea uma lava na poloai mai ai le ALII ia te ia, ua faapea lava ona faia e ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.
verses.sm: O le uluai masina i le tausaga e lua, o le uluai aso o lea masina ua faatuina ai le malumalu.

verses.en: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
verses.sm: Ua faatuina ai e Mose o le malumalu, ua na tuu foi ona lago, ma faatu ona laupapa, ma sulu atu ai ona faalava, ma faatuina ona pou;

verses.en: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: ua na fofola foi le ufiufi i luga o le malumalu, ma faaee ai le ufiufi o le fale fetafai i ona luga e aupito a luga; faapei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
verses.sm: Ua ia ave foi ma tuu papa maa o le tulafono i le atolaau, ma sulu atu amo i le atolaau, ma faaee le nofoa o le alofa i luga o le atolaau.

verses.en: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: Ona avatu lea e ia o le atolaau i totonu o le malumalu, ma na tautau le ie puipui, ma na puipui a'i le atolaau o le tulafono; e pei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
verses.sm: Ua ia tuu foj le laoai i le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga i le itu i matu o le malumalu, i le itu mai O le ie puipui.

verses.en: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.sm: Ua ia teuteua foi le areto i ona luga i luma o le ALII; e pei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.sm: Ona tuu lea e ia o le tuugalamepa i le fale fetafai o le faapo148 topotoga i le itu i toga o le malumalu, e feagai ma le laoai.

verses.en: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: Ua na tutu foi lamepa i luma o le ALII; e pei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
verses.sm: Ua ia tuu foi le fata auro i le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga i luma o le ie puipui.

verses.en: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: Ua ia faamu foi i ona luga le mea manogi; e pei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.
verses.sm: Ua ia tautau foi le ie puipui o le faitotoa o le malumalu.

verses.en: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: O le fata e fai ai taulaga mu foi na ia tuu ai i le faitotoa O le malumalu o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga, ma osi ai le taulaga mu ma le taulaga i mea e “ai; e pei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.
verses.sm: Ua ia tuu foi le tanoa e mulumulu ai i le va o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga ma le fata faitaulaga; ua ia sasaa foi i ai le vai e taele ai;

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.sm: o Mose foi, ma Arona, atoa ma ona atalii na mulumulu ai o latou lima ma o latou vae;

verses.en: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.sm: ua latou mulumulu ai ina a ulufale atu i latou i le malumalu, pe faalatalata i le fata faitaulaga; e pei ona poloai mai ai o le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
verses.sm: Ua ia faatuina foi le lotoá e siosioina ai le malumalu ma le fata faitaulaga, ma na tautau le ie puipui i le faitotoa O le lotoā; ua faauma foi e Mose le galuega.

verses.en: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
verses.sm: Ona ufitia lea o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga i le a0, ua tumu foi le malumalu i le pupula o le ALII;

verses.en: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
verses.sm: ua le mafaia foi e Mose ona ulufale atu i le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga, aua ua nofo le ao i ona luga; o le pupula foi o le ALI ua tumu ai le malumalu.

verses.en: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:
verses.sm: A siitia foi le ao ai luga o le malumalu, ona o atu ai lea o le fanauga a Isaraelu i la latou malaga uma.

verses.en: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
verses.sm: A e afai ua le siitia le ao, ona le o malaga lea o i latou ina seia oo i le aso e siitia ai.

verses.en: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
verses.sm: Auā o le ao o le ALII sa i luga lava o le malumalu i le ao; sa i ona luga foi le afi i le po, i luma o le aiga uma o Isaraelu, i la latou malaga uma.
